tests.title: 1: successful DOMContentLoaded navigation resolves on the first attempt
2: a delayed load event never blocks — navigation uses domcontentloaded
3: a transient navigation failure is retried and then succeeds
4: navigation gives up with NavigationError once the retry limit is reached
5: a readiness-element timeout is reported WITHOUT re-navigating the browser
6: never retries beyond the bounded budget (no infinite retry)
7: navigates with the exact urlFor(routes.X) string (navigation URL contract preserved)
8: urlRegex(routes.X) is a RegExp for assertions only, never a navigation target
isTransientNavError flags timeouts/resets/interruptions but not app errors
